name: Release Version
description: Displays the current version in the toolbar
project_description:
A small utility module that displays the current release version of your website in the toolbar. The module looks for the value to display in a configurable environment variable.

 

 For configuration steps see the documentation pages .

 For later versions it is planned that Release Version will switch to a plugin-based system, allowing for various ways of determining the version number, e.g. using Git information or simply loading the version from a text file. Feel free to contributes ideas and code in the issue queue .
